reviewAxisRegistration.policyRef: DL-30 verification v2 — eight independent review axes
notes: All eight review axes are model-mediated (model_advisory) reviewers promoted to blocking by locked policy; none is deterministic.
A deterministic wrapper launching a model reviewer never reclassifies the verdict as deterministic (DL-30 REC-4).

The architecture axis ships a concrete selected-harness runner in this starter; every axis's live semantic verdict is pending-live, executed by the operator's selected harness via the review-agent registry.
Each axis runs independently and produces a schema-validated review_finding_set; a single combined reviewer is forbidden.
